tasks.description: Add a light/dark theme toggle control in the application's Settings page. Toggling it immediately switches the active theme. The toggle should be accessible and follow the existing design tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the Settings page, when the theme toggle is clicked, then the active theme is updated.

tasks.description: Store the user's selected theme in localStorage so the same theme is applied automatically on the user's next visit. Ensure the storage is secure and follows best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user closes and reopens the application, then the previously selected theme is applied.

tasks.description: On the first load, when the user has no stored preference, honor the operating system setting via the prefers-color-scheme media query to choose the initial theme. Ensure the media query is correctly implemented and follows best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no stored theme preference, when the application is loaded, then the theme is set based on the operating system's preferred color scheme.

tasks.description: Apply the active theme consistently to all pages and shared components of the application. Ensure the theme is applied correctly and follows the existing design tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user navigates to any page, then the theme is consistently applied to all elements.

tasks.description: Write tests to ensure the theme toggle functionality works as expected. Test cases should cover different scenarios, including theme persistence and system preference.
acceptance_criteria: Given the test suite is run, when all tests pass, then the theme toggle functionality is working correctly.
